resources.string: Touch: the move stick appears under your thumb in the lower left; skills on the right (A primary, B X Y R around it, ZR above), drag a skill to aim, II = second skill set (holds the modifier while a skill is used); bottom row = d-pad and +, top = ZL L L3, − R3. Tap the world = A, touch and hold = walk there. MENU switches to menu gestures (tap = A, long press = hold A, swipe = d-pad, two fingers = B); + and − switch to it by themselves.
Makes the hero walk the way the finger points. Push the stick at 45 degrees: if the hero walks flatter than the finger, raise it.
Turn toward the point, then A
Touch and hold the world = walk toward the finger
The game has no touch support of its own: menus are driven with the gamepad buttons. Use the stick swipe for round (radial) menus.
